name: TO THE CORE
author: Garrett Hale
description: A semi-idle game: guide Pant Ant on his journey home to the center of the earth, with Wormie explaining the rules. Z opens the tool kit, X picks and uses a tool.

descriptions.en: A semi-idle game: guide Pant Ant on his journey home to the center of the earth, with Wormie explaining the rules. Z opens the tool kit, X picks and uses a tool.
descriptions.it: Un gioco semi-idle: accompagna Pant Ant nel viaggio verso casa, al centro della Terra, con Wormie a spiegarti le regole. Z apre gli attrezzi, X sceglie e usa un attrezzo.
